relationships.subject: NKCC1
relationships.evidence_quote: An increase in NKCC1 expression was accompanied by suppressed KCC2 expression.

relationships.subject: Bumetanide
relationships.evidence_quote: After treatment, the KCC2 expression level increased with the Bu and Bu+Mge groups exhibiting significant differences when compared with the SCI group (p < 0.05)

relationships.subject: MGE cell transplantation
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression levels of GABA-A receptors were significantly increased in both the spinal cord and DRG of the MGE group and the Bu+MGE group compared with those in the SCI group (p < 0.01)

relationships.subject: Bumetanide
relationships.evidence_quote: both Bu monotherapy and combination therapy directly inhibited IκB degradation and P65 nuclear translocation, effectively blocking the activation of the NF-κB pathway

key_findings: Bumetanide plus MGE transplantation additively relieved SCI neuropathic pain
Bumetanide corrected NKCC1/KCC2 imbalance in spinal cord and DRG and blocked NF-kB/microglia; MGE raised GABA-A receptors and GAD
